orientation.top_of_map: north wall (the table and dresser wall)
orientation.note_en: Room 11 x 7 m, per the kitchen architecture card's interior layout. The only door is centred in the south (bottom) wall with the bell-board beside it; the open hearth with cauldron is centred in the west (left) end wall with the hearth slab in front; the three-legged stool is dead centre; the deal table and the dresser stand against the north wall; the copper-pan rail is on the east (right) end wall. Camera positions in views[] are described relative to these landmarks.

landmarks.name: copper pans
landmarks.name_en: the copper pans on the east wall
